relatedBusinessListings.heading: Superfood Cafe Featuring Acai Bowls & Smoothies
relatedBusinessListings.summary:
Founded in 2011, this established franchise is a fast-casual superfood café offering a diverse menu of bowls, smoothies, juices, wraps, toasts, paninis, and grain bowls. The concept is centered around nutrient-dense “superfoods,” with a focus on ingredients rich in antioxidants and vitamins. All items are made-to-order, allowing for a high degree of customization to accommodate a wide range of dietary preferences and restrictions.
The business is currently operated on an absentee basis; however, it offers substantial growth potential for an engaged owner-operator who can enhance sales and optimize day-to-day performance. Financial information is based on their January through December 2025 P&L, with Owner’s Cash Flow of $6,229 and an average monthly Owner’s Cash Flow of $519, adding back manager’s wages, assuming an owner operator.
relatedBusinessListings.support: 15 days familiarization included in asking price

relatedBusinessListings.heading: Established Medical Aesthetics Practice|$192K+ Premium Equipment
relatedBusinessListings.summary:
This established medical aesthetics and wellness practice offers a turnkey opportunity with a loyal client base, diversified revenue streams, and approximately $192,450 in FF&E and inventory included in the sale. The practice features advanced aesthetic and wellness technology, including Exion, Emsculpt Neo, Emsella, and DiamondGlow systems, providing a significant platform for continued growth without the need for substantial upfront equipment investment.

A compelling opportunity exists for a sales- and marketing-focused owner to increase utilization of the existing technology, grow memberships, expand the client base, and introduce additional providers and services. With the infrastructure, equipment, and operating foundation already in place, the business offers significant upside for an owner focused on business development and growth.

Investment Highlights

	Approximately $192,450 in FF&E and inventory
	Advanced Exion, Emsculpt Neo, Emsella & DiamondGlow technology
	Established practice with loyal and recurring clientele
	Multiple aesthetic and wellness revenue streams
	Significant unused equipment and treatment capacity
	Strong opportunity for a sales- and marketing-driven owner
	Growth potential through memberships, providers & increased utilization
	Seller training and transition support

Contact Brent Bengtson at 602-448-1522. Transworld Business Advisors Phoenix for additional information and to learn more about this opportunity.

relatedBusinessListings.competition:
The health-focused café segment continues to grow, and consumer demand for clean, ingredient-forward food in accessible neighborhood settings is as strong as it's ever been in Denver. This brand sits squarely in that trend — with a menu built around smoothies, acai bowls, loaded toasts, and specialty coffee that appeals to health-conscious regulars and curious new visitors alike.

NW Denver's neighborhoods are among the city's most active and community-oriented, with strong spending power and a customer base that actively supports local independent businesses. This brand already belongs there. It just needs an owner who does too.

BUSINESS HIGHLIGHTS:
• Two prime locations in high-foot-traffic NW Denver neighborhoods with captive audiences
• Proven operational model with established systems and turn-key staff in place
• Strong positioning in the growing health-focused café segment
• Menu built around trending items: smoothies, acai bowls, loaded toasts, specialty coffee
• Refined brand identity with completed menu R&D, interior design, and operational systems

FINANCIALS:

• Asking Price: $110,000

• Currently absentee-owned with managers and staff operating independently
• Located in community-oriented neighborhoods with strong spending power
• Customer base actively supports local independent businesses
• All foundational work completed: concept development, neighborhood reputation established
